description: AbstractEntityService class providing core entity management functionalities such as saving entities, managing relations, constraint violation checks, debug settings updates, and entity name uniquification within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: AbstractEntityService
classes.description: Provides core functionalities for entity management, including saving entities with locking, relation management, constraint violation handling, debug settings updates, and entity name uniqueness enforcement.

methods.name: saveEntity
methods.description: Saves an entity, applying a lock if the entity is new to prevent concurrent creation issues.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Creates a relation between entities via the relationService.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a relation between entities via the relationService.

methods.name: extractConstraintViolationException
methods.description: Extracts a ConstraintViolationException from a generic exception if present.

methods.name: checkConstraintViolation
methods.description: Checks if an exception violates specified database constraints and throws DataValidationException if so.

methods.name: checkAssignedEntityViewsToEdge
methods.description: Validates that entity views are not assigned to an edge before unassigning.

methods.name: updateDebugSettings
methods.description: Updates debug settings for an entity based on current debug mode and profile.

methods.name: getMaxDebugAllUntil
methods.description: Calculates the maximum timestamp until debug mode is active based on profile and default durations.

methods.name: uniquifyEntityName
methods.description: Ensures entity name uniqueness by appending suffixes or random strings based on conflict strategy.

methods.name: generateUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique name by appending an index or random string until no conflict exists.
